title: VISION 100M Stage 3 Post-Training Comprehensive Audit & Generation Quality Registry
justification: While Stage 3 successfully lowered training loss to 5.98, tightened validation perplexity to 2100.9, and reduced first-token entropy from 8.019 to 7.545, the model remains severely undertrained at 174,080 cumulative tokens (0.0087% of 2B Chinchilla optimal compute). The benchmark accuracy delta against Stage 2 is statistically inconclusive (0.0% vs 0.0%). Generation remains incoherent babble with high repetition in open-ended settings. Gemini remains JARVIS production primary.
production_guardrail: Gemini 2.5 / 3.5 remains the active production primary for JARVIS

loss_plateau_forensic_diagnosis.root_cause_explanation: 1. Fixed Validation Subset: The validation loop evaluated the exact same 20 un-shuffled batches (40 sequences). 2. Learning Rate Annealing: The cosine schedule decayed LR from 3.01e-05 at step 128 to 1.50e-05 at step 160, reducing parameter update magnitude to 3.09e-04. 3. Representation Saturation: The model had reached its loss minimum for this batch subset given the low capacity and undertrained state, resulting in identical rounded loss (7.6501) while Shannon entropy tightened from 7.689 to 7.615.

statistical_comparison.conclusion: No statistically meaningful improvement over Stage 2 in raw factual benchmark pass rate, though internal representation entropy tightened.
